suggested_change: Define explicit rules: (1) Carry-forward scores require documented contradiction to downgrade, not absence of new confirmation; (2) Evidence thresholds (e.g., quantification requirement for Metrics) must be defined at rubric setup, not applied retroactively; (3) Next steps must specify concrete questions in scoring criteria, not as agent implementation detail; (4) Score changes require citation of new contradicting evidence, not restatement of known constraints.
